result_scope: Original-coordinate zero-self bank I plus two original coordinates j,k whose cross columns into I are collinear; nonzero quadratic curvature in the pair direction transverse to the cross direction. Arbitrary outside original coordinates/couplings are allowed by conditioning and become affine terms.
result: If kappa0 is the Euclidean norm of the two collinear cross-column coefficients and tau is the transverse pair curvature, then the full ambient form has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2^(9/4)3^(3/4) kappa0^(-3/4)|tau|^(-1/4).
premises: Rudelson-Vershynin arXiv:1402.4492 Theorem 1.2: a normalized linear combination of independent cap-one coordinates has density cap sqrt(2).
Two selected original-coordinate densities have product joint density cap one; an orthogonal two-dimensional change preserves that joint cap but does not preserve independence, which is not used.
Elementary bathtub estimates proved in REPORT.md for the square subprobability pushforward and the critical marginal integral.
